companies.name: Zermicor
companies.description: Zermicor is a venture developing advanced medical imaging solutions based on optical fiber sensing technology to improve cardiovascular interventions. Its intravascular photoacoustic imaging platform provides surgeons with real-time, detailed insights into blood vessel conditions, including the location, thickness, and composition of lipid deposits that influence stent placement decisions. By enabling more precise diagnosis and treatment planning, Zermicor aims to reduce complications from cardiovascular procedures and improve patient outcomes. The technology has the potential to support applications beyond coronary vascular disease, including peripheral and cerebral vascular disease and organ inspection.

companies.name: MarisCarbon
companies.description: MarisCarbon has developed a patented, retrofit-ready system that abates 100% methane slip directly from ship exhaust – independent of engine type and simple to install. It also includes a quantification solution for monitoring, reporting and verification. This innovation helps operators to meet compliance goals while delivering immediate climate impact.

companies.name: Perovix
companies.description: Perovix is a venture developing advanced X-ray detection technology based on perovskite materials. Its next-generation detector platform is designed to deliver higher performance, larger detector sizes, and lower costs than conventional solutions. By providing a scalable platform for OEMs, PeroviX aims to unlock new imaging capabilities across medical, industrial, and security applications.

companies.name: LubaLabs
companies.description: LubaLabs is a venture developing a high-throughput 3D mechanical imaging platform to advance fibrosis research and accelerate the development of new therapies. Using its patented Brillouin microscopy technology, the platform enables researchers to non-invasively monitor changes in the mechanical properties of living 3D tissue models over time. By providing early insights into tissue stiffening, a key driver of fibrosis, LubaLabs helps improve disease detection and enables more reliable evaluation of potential anti-fibrotic drugs.

companies.name: Grape Systems
companies.description: Grape Systems is a venture working to make advanced manufacturing more efficient, less wasteful, and more sustainable. Founded in 2026 through the HighTechXL venture building program, the company is developing an inline metrology solution that provides manufacturers with real-time visibility into quality and process performance. By replacing offline and intrusive measurements with continuous, in-process monitoring, Grape Systems helps manufacturers reduce waste, improve efficiency, and unlock greater value in the production of advanced materials, electronics, energy systems, and medical technologies.

companies.name: Vialign
companies.description: Displacement sensing in Semiconductor manufacturing, real-time measurement of the position of wafers, reticles and bonding heads, is not just a support function; it is the fundamental enabler of yield and device performance. Vialign offers precise, robust and easy-to-install displacement sensing, integrated on a photonic chip.

companies.name: FlowVolta
companies.description: FlowVolta develops electrochemical systems for hydrogen production that tackle some of the most pressing limitations in today’s clean energy transition. As demand for hydrogen grows across industries, existing electrochemical technologies often face challenges in efficiency, cost, and scalability. Founded in 2025 by specialists with deep expertise in the hydrogen sector, FlowVolta was created to rethink how electrochemical systems are designed and deployed. The team identified that incremental improvements were not enough—fundamental innovation was needed to unlock real industrial impact. By focusing on next-generation system architectures, FlowVolta is building electrochemical systems for hydrogen production that deliver higher performance while remaining economically viable at scale. Their approach combines engineering innovation with a strong understanding of industrial requirements, ensuring that solutions are not only technically advanced but also practical to implement. These advancements are particularly important as hydrogen becomes a key pillar in decarbonizing sectors such as heavy industry, mobility, and energy storage. Improving the efficiency and scalability of electrochemical systems directly reduces the cost of hydrogen, accelerating its adoption worldwide. FlowVolta’s mission is to enable a new generation of electrochemical production technologies that support a cleaner, more sustainable energy system. companies.name: High Tech Binders
companies.description: High Tech Binders is developing a bio-based, carbon-negative asphalt binder (ECO-Bind) designed to replace fossil bitumen in road construction. Their technology uses a biopolymer derived from wastewater to partially substitute traditional asphalt materials. The result is a hybrid binder that can be used in existing asphalt plants and helps reduce CO₂ emissions in road infrastructure while maintaining performance standards. The company focuses on scaling sustainable road materials for municipalities and infrastructure partners in Europe and beyond.

companies.name: Bambi Medical
companies.description: Bambi Medical is a MedTech company founded in November 2015 by Sidarto and Fabio Bambang Oetomo. The objective of the company is to reduce pain and stress in pre-term infants and improve parent-child bonding. In order to achieve this objective, Bambi Medical designs, develops and manufactures products for Neonatal Intensive Care Units in hospitals.

companies.name: Accerion
companies.description: Accerion provides a positioning module as a single system for integration in new and existing equipment. This module enables manufacturers of robots and automatic vehicles to create new flexible and cost-effective logistics solutions. These solutions will drive automation and efficiency in warehousing, manufacturing and many other industries.

companies.name: SonicPrecision
companies.description: SonicPrecision is an early-stage MedTech startup with technology roots in Philips. They are active in the field of interventional cardiology and focus on improving treatment of cardiac arrhythmias using a novel ablation catheter design. By embedding ultrasound sensors in the tip of the ablation catheter, Sonic Precision provides imaging and sensing capabilities during the intervention, allowing the electrophysiologist to adapt the procedure to patient-specific characteristics. With this closed-loop approach, the venture aspires to create a new standard in the treatment of rhythm disorders in the heart by offering better options for the individual patient.

companies.name: VitalWear
companies.description: VitalWear uses optical fiber sensing technology to monitor relevant parameters for non-invasive medical applications. Photonic measurement technology is integrated into textiles such as bed sheets, mattress covers or clothing, which enables continuous and autonomous patient monitoring with high patient comfort and with low effort for the care providers. VitalWear initially focuses on pressure ulcer prevention, via improving patient-specific risk assessment and facilitating early detection. Its solution significantly reduces the time that the nursing staff needs to spend on prevention protocols and helps to achieve lower pressure ulcer incidences.

companies.name: Veridis
companies.description: Veridis develops the patented, innovative MADSCAN technology. Veridis MADSCAN is a revolutionary technology, transforming the plastics recycling industry. MADSCAN provides unparalleled accuracy (>99%) in characterising complex mixed plastic streams.

companies.name: Senergetics
companies.description: Senergetics is revolutionizing asset health management for process industries, specializing in Insulation Performance Scanning (IPS), Corrosion Under Insulation (CUI) Detection, and Real-time Leak Detection (RTL). Senergetic’s disruptive sensing technologies ensures non-intrusive, continuous monitoring, utilizing data and AI to prevent equipment failures and minimize downtime.

companies.name: Luper Technologies
companies.description: Luper’s mission is to clean our skies from air pollution by enabling industrial companies to eliminate their toxic and odorous emissions through our future-proof air cleaning systems. The venture strives for zero air pollution to protect our planet and the people living on it. Its revolutionary, patented industrial air cleaning system the ‘AirShield’ is developed as a effective, efficient and sustainable solution to reduce the social, environmental, and financial burdens of air pollution from harsh industrial exhaust air.

companies.name: Keiron
companies.description: Keiron is revolutionizing the Surface Mount Technology (SMT) industry with its groundbreaking Laser Induced Forward Transfer (LIFT) technology. Based in Eindhoven’s High-Tech ecosystem, Keiron delivers a fully digital, contactless printing solution that eliminates the limitations and compromises of traditional stencil and jet printing. By combining precision, efficiency, and flexibility, Keiron is setting a new standard for electronics manufacturing.

companies.name: InPhocal
companies.description: InPhocal uses a unique laser beam technology that will revolutionize the field of laser processing. The long focus depth of its beam will speed up laser marking systems. The long focus depth also allows for marking on curved surfaces without loss in quality. The laser beam can also be focused down to smaller spot sizes than current technology. This results in higher precision for wafer dicing. This increases chip yield and can help solving our current global chip shortage problem.

companies.name: Inner
companies.description: Inner bridges the gap in EV battery diagnostics by providing you with a complete picture. Their proprietary, non-invasive CT (Computed Tomography) scanner, designed for comprehensive analysis of complete EV battery packs, is seamlessly integrated with advanced machine learning (ML) software. This innovative technology enables rapid detection and analysis of microscopic physical faults with exceptional accuracy, supporting circularity, safety and efficiency in the EV ecosystem.

companies.name: Carbyon
companies.description: Carbyon aims to restore the atmospheric carbon balance using breakthrough technology and unique machine design that scales economically and durably.

companies.name: AVOXT
companies.description: Creating advanced technologies for extremely efficient hydrogen production. Their vision is that hydrogen becomes cheaper than fossil fuels so that every industry will accelerate to a net-zero economy. Avoxt is taking action to accelerate decarbonisation by making green hydrogen a cheaper alternative to fossil fuels.

companies.name: Astrape Networks
companies.description: Astrape Networks was founded in 2022 to redefine data center networking with high-performance, low-latency solutions. Astrape’s mission is to develop advanced optical networks that seamlessly handle the increasing demands of AI, high-frequency trading and data-intensive applications. With a focus on performance, flexibility, and sustainability, Astrape Networks is building the foundation for the future of AI-ready data centers.

companies.name: Aircision
companies.description: Aircision uses space-grade technology and deploys it in terrestrial networks. With a world-class alignment system, Aircision is able to cover great distances while delivering high bandwidth.
